scope: Precomputed bitmap coverage faces owned by shared font workers/catalog/TextSystem, plus thin native Font map/unmap semantic bindings.

source.reviewed: Complete PrerenderedFont.cpp/.h; LayerBitmapImpl global font map/unmap and character data/getTextSize; native Font registration in LayerIntf.

implementation.core_input: FontLoadSource::PrecomputedStorage { path, pixel_size } / PrecomputedBytes { bytes, pixel_size }
implementation.public_script: Text.beginPrecomputedFont(alias, asset, pixelSize): int; uses existing fontStatus, measurement and release methods.
implementation.native_policy: Native Font signature face/height/bold/italic/angle maps to a shared canonical alias. An async worker pause preserves ordering. Unmap removes the signature binding; retained engine text nodes keep their immutable face. Baked native bold is not synthesized again.
implementation.limits: 32MiB encoded source, 65536 strictly ordered BMP characters, 4MP coverage per glyph, 64MiB total face coverage, 256MiB shared host font resident budget including decoded coverage reserved before allocation; cancellation checked while indexing and decoding.
implementation.metrics: Original bearings, IncX/IncY and scalar Inc are retained separately. TFT has no nominal pixel size/ascent header: callers declare pixel size, shared portable line pitch uses that size and baseline ascent is the maximum stored origin. Explicit positioned glyphs can use caller baseline. Native GDI/FreeType pixel parity is not claimed.
implementation.boundaries: Fixed declared size only. Missing glyphs fail explicitly; native OS font fallback outside the mapped bitmap face is not yet implemented. Complex shaping of bitmap faces is unsupported, not replaced with an outline font.

verification: Self-authored in-memory 2x2 half-coverage glyph fixture; no font files or user data committed. Separate decoder tests, worker publication/client isolation/frozen lifetime tests, adapter test and actual game execution logs.
